agendas.name: The Blaze
agendas.text: When this agenda advances, each investigator takes 1 damage. Spawn the Servant of Flame at the strongest fire.

agendas.name: The Inferno
agendas.text: When this agenda advances, each investigator takes 2 damage and 1 horror.

agendas.name: The Heart of the Fire
agendas.text: The Servant of Flame gets -1 fight for each bless token in the chaos bag.

acts.name: The Investigation Begins
acts.text: You arrive at Miskatonic University to investigate the fire. Gather clues to learn what happened.

acts.name: The Source of the Fire
acts.text: The fire is spreading. Find the source before it consumes the campus.

acts.name: Confront the Servant
acts.text: Defeat the Servant of Flame to end the blaze.
